name: end-trigger
description: The flat island's clock. The game ends when one seat completes its Nth island delivery, and N is FLAT across seat counts, so the same N is half the 2-seat island's 12 delivery spaces, a third of the 3-seat island's 18 and a quarter of the 4-seat island's 24. Shipped at 6. Sweep it and read game length, unfinished games, the island fill fraction at the end and the winning score off each cell - and read them PER SEAT COUNT, because a value that suits 4p may leave 2p grinding. If the 2-seat game is the one that misbehaves, the alternatives to a bigger N are a per-seat row here or a smaller 2p island in slotsBySeats; do not reach for the VP.
